s.note: Medjool dates with almond and pepper, fried in butter and honey
s.how: Toast 24 whole almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes. Slit and pit 24 Medjool dates, push an almond and a grind of black pepper into each and press closed. Melt 30g butter in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the dates 2 minutes, turning, until warm and glossy. Add 3 tbsp honey and let it bubble for 1 minute, turning the dates to coat. Tip onto a plate and sprinkle with flaky salt.

s.n: Macrinus's baked feta with figs and honey
s.note: Baked feta with olives, figs, oregano and chilli, crusty bread
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Put a 200g block of feta in a small baking dish with 150g mixed olives around it. Halve 4 fresh figs and nestle them in. Drizzle with 3 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, chilli flakes and thyme sprigs. Bake 15 minutes until the feta is soft. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and serve with torn crusty bread.

m.note: Whole roast chicken glazed with honey on a bed of carrots
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg whole chicken with oil, salt, crushed garlic and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon. Roast at 200C on a bed of 6 carrots for 60 minutes, then brush with 3 tbsp honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky. Rest 10 minutes and carve.

w.note: Baked ricotta and honey cheesecake with lemon zest
w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 3 eggs, 4 tbsp honey and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Cool and drizzle with 2 tbsp more honey.

d.note: Warm red wine with honey, cinnamon, pepper, bay and orange peel
d.how: Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a saucepan with 4 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick, 6 black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves and 3 strips of orange peel. Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves. Do not let it boil. Strain into 4 heavy cups. For non-drinkers, make it the same way with red grape juice and less honey.
